# A `posted:` block with no `due:` line.
#
# Every key in a posted block is required — the writer and the comparison both
# read them outright — and a hand-written block is where one goes missing. Read
# outright, the missing key surfaced as its own name and nothing else:
# `Error: invoice "INV-NODUE": 'due'`. That says neither that the field is
# required, nor which block wanted it, nor what to write.
#
# What this fixture produces: a refusal naming the field and the block.
#
# Verified by tests/integration/test_a_missing_required_field_is_named.py.
2026-01-01 commodity CAD
	mnemonic: "CAD"
	fullname: "Canadian Dollar"
	namespace: "CURRENCY"
	fraction: 100
2026-01-01 open Income
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Income:Sales
	type: Income
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets
	type: Asset
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"
2026-01-01 open Assets:Accounts Receivable
	type: Accounts Receivable
	commodity.namespace: "CURRENCY"
	commodity.mnemonic: "CAD"

customer "C-NODUE"
	name: "No Due Customer"
	currency: CAD

invoice "INV-NODUE"
	customer_id: "C-NODUE"
	currency: CAD
	date_opened: 2026-01-01
	entry:
		date: 2026-01-01
		description: "A line"
		account: "Income:Sales"
		quantity: 1
		price: 100
		taxable: false
		tax_included: false
	posted:
		date: 2026-01-01
		ar_account: "Assets:Accounts Receivable"
		memo: "Invoice INV-NODUE"
		accumulate: true
